information_flow: The first call receives every common input and emits one complete executable policy closure with a single active state and reversible candidate-caused transformation. The final call consumes that closure, directly receives only task, anchor_contract, and task_constraints, and emits the same lineage as one complete policy after preserving or causally rolling back its active transformation.
name: Transactional Causal Rollback Edge
organization: two-call sequential nonbranching lineage carrying one reversible executable closure through an evidence-triggered terminal state transition

calls.objective: Reconcile the available evidence and obligations into one complete executable policy closure whose candidate-caused transformation is reversible within the same sole artifact, without creating parallel alternatives.

Consume construct_reversible_closure and the visible normative inputs, preserve its active state unless a specific normative contradiction is causally attributable to its transformation, and on that evidence transition the same artifact to its restored state before emitting one complete policy.
